decisions.Q-9: no - single currency (USD); remove the six-value selector, no rate source exists

decisions.Q-12: out of scope - no production deployment for this hackathon; the mock Express API remains the datastore and Phase 2 Step 4 loses its Azure form

Three dependency-table conventions coexist: Dependency/Type/Direction/Description, Depends on/Why/Evidence, and Dependency/Version/Used for/Where. Direction was added in prose to the two that lacked it rather than by rewriting the tables.
